title: 皐月賞の後に・難きゆえに尊し

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After losing the Satsuki Sho, Yaeno Muteki is left to reflect on her weaknesses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki can't hide her frustration. She swears to win her next race and prove that she's on the right path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown tour has only just begun. Our next race is the Japanese Derby!
